name: TailAdmin
author: VM Engine
description: TailAdmin-faithful theme for Synapse backend admin: clean white/near-black sidebar, TailAdmin's real design tokens, comprehensive UI components

color_scheme.primary: TailAdmin brand blue (#465fff, from lta.css design tokens)
color_scheme.dark_mode: Supported via .dark class toggle (Alpine darkMode, persisted), matching lta.css's @custom-variant dark (&:is(.dark *))

components.sidebar: Collapsible sidebar, white (light) / near-black (dark) background, TailAdmin style
components.header: Fixed header with search and user menu
components.forms: Styled form inputs with validation states

customization.typography: Adjust font sizes and weights in @theme
